assets.rightsBasis: Official VPMM college crest served from the college's own domain (engineering.vpmm.in) and used on its site. No open licence; used only to identify the institution. Checked 2026-10-22: HTTP 200, image/png, 139,379 bytes, 561x561 px, transparent background. Rendered on white and visually confirmed legible: green ring reading 'V.P. Muthiah Pillai - Meenakshi Ammal Trust', yellow centre with a green temple-tower figure and the words 'Prosperity', 'Truth', 'Work' in red, and a green ribbon reading 'V.P. Muthaiah Pillai Meenakshi Ammal College of Engineering & Technology'. Square, so it suits small tiles. Alternative wide lock-up (crest plus 'ARUL THARUM VPMM COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY' wordmark, 'Counselling Code - 4979') at https://engineering.vpmm.in/img/Logo/ENGINEERING%20LOGO-01.png (2433x608 px, also legible on white) was not chosen because it embeds a counselling-code line.

Official institutional photograph in the homepage carousel of the college's own domain (engineering.vpmm.in). No open licence; used only to depict the institution. Checked 2026-10-22: HTTP 200, image/jpeg, 400,419 bytes, 1366x768 px (landscape). Visually confirmed as a single real aerial (drone) photograph, not a composite or AI image: a twin-lane entrance avenue with a flowering median and palm and neem trees leads to a blue-fronted three-storey college block with a second building to the left; no text overlay or watermark; no identifiable people. Rejected: img/College/collegepic.jpg (building frontage carries the former '... Engineering College for Women' signage, which would misstate the current name), img/College/college2.jpg (crowded event photo with identifiable students).
assets.altText: Aerial view of the tree-lined entrance avenue leading to the main block of Arul Tharum VPMM College of Engineering and Technology at Krishnankoil
